versions.subject: feat: update gpg4win rules
versions.detection:
selection_metadata:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '\gpg.exe'
        - '\gpg2.exe'
    - Description: 'GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -c '
        - 'passphrase'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\gpg.exe", "*\\gpg2.exe") OR Description="GnuPG’s OpenPGP tool" CommandLine="* -c *" CommandLine="*passphrase*"
